correctness.rationale: The proof applies back-and-forth induction to third-vertex extension profiles for ordered pairs, including equality cases, and then to sets of pointed profiles. Manhattan geometry restricts pair types by adjacency, distance two and common neighbors, with explicit exceptional small grids and a finite neighbor-union bound guaranteeing common nonneighbors elsewhere. Independent first-principles profile code on all 2<=m<=n<=12 found precisely five classes, singleton (2,2),(2,3),(2,4),(3,3) and all other grids including (2,5) and (3,4). The source coordinate argument (not bounded enumeration) establishes the infinite last class and sharp representative bound 10.
